content:
Meeting: Launch Crunch Weekly — quick notes (informal).
Date: 2026-03-08 | Owner: Ethan Chen (personal notes)
Attendees: Ethan, Priya, Anita, Diego + optional: Sam (SRE) popped in for 15m.

High-level intention: final stretch prep for mid-March release. Keep this as my runbook + scratchpad. Use it during standups and 1:1s. Not polished.

Key observations (raw):
- Canary ran overnight; saw an error spike around 02:12 UTC. Errors correlated with long KV cache misses. (raw logs summarized, need deeper trace)
- Token cost per request bumped ~6% for a short window during canary; could be related to new tokenizer align patch.
- Autoscaler behaved as expected when CPU hit 78%, but tails still present.

Immediate blockers (what would block GO):
1) Unresolved canary error spike (owner: Priya/analytics). If reproduces with debug flags => BLOCK.
2) Token-cost regression above threshold (>=5% sustained) without mitigation plan => BLOCK.
3) No validated rollback image or smoke test => BLOCK (we must have a tested rollback ready).

Runbook notes / steps to verify before final go/no-go:
- Smoke test matrix: 50 req/s for 10 min, 99th p50/p95/p99 captured, embedding and chat endpoints both. (Ethan)
- Canary rerun with debug flags: include kv-cache tracing, kernel selection logging (Priya)
- Hot path unit tests for quantized kernels (Diego)
- Ops: ensure circuit-breaker thresholds set for region EU-west-1 to 90% (Sam)
Escalation and fallback policy (quick draft):
- If canary error rate >1.5% for >30m after fixes -> switch traffic to v1-quantized variant (automated fallback).
- If token-cost regression persists >48h and no safe mitigation -> pause global launch and move to staged opt-in.
- Contact list: eng-oncall -> Sam; Head of Infra -> Diego; PM -> Priya; Exec notify -> Maya (if pause).

Checks that are "nice-to-have" but not blocking:
- Console dashboards updated with new cost breakdown granularity (Anita)
- Rollout A/B experiment gating doc finalized (product)

Notes to self (scratch):
- Remember to ask @Priya about sampling window length — current 5m may be too coarse.
- Follow up with QA on flaky integration test "chat-stream-bulk-02" (irregular failures).
- Quick adhoc: re-run canary with tokenization patch reverted to verify cost delta.

Meeting cadence decisions:
- Keep weekly 30m sync until GO. If blockers persist, add midweek deep-dive.
- 1:1 action: schedule 15m with Diego on Thursday to sign off on kernel smoke tests.

Checklist (single view, mark when done):
[ ] Canary rerun w/debug flags (Priya)
[ ] Rollback image built + smoke tests (Ethan)
[ ] Batching config validated (Diego)
[ ] Status page + customer messaging drafted (Anita)
[ ] Risk register updated (shared Confluence link)

Quick links (for my reference):
- ENG-1451 (canary failure)
- OPS-2028 (autoscaler behavior notes)
- Confluence: LAUNCH-2026/Final-Plan (latest doc)
- Slack thread: #launch-liftoff-thread

Closing thoughts:
- We are close but still itchy about the cost blip. Don’t be rushed into GO without a tested rollback. Prioritize reproducibility of the error over finger-pointing.
- Keep comms tight: if anything looks off in the re-run, escalate immediately.

End of scratchbook entry.
